title: Stripe Integration Guide
summary: Setup guide for Stripe payments, Stripe Tax, and webhook handling in Mercora, covering API keys, environment variables, file structure, and API endpoints.
notes: Type set by manifest (DOC). Content also contains API endpoint request/response schemas (SPEC-like signals) and a pricing-authority statement for /api/payment-intent; manifest type honored. Output filename uses a path-derived suffix instead of a SHA-256 hash because no shell tool is available to this agent.
